PRODUCT DESIGNER - PLENO  A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.    Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais  para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás  confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.   Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência . Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?   Qual será o seu papel? Como Product Designer Pleno, você será a ponte entre as necessidades de negócio de um grande player do setor de infraestrutura e as dores dos usuários finais. Seu papel é garantir que cada funcionalidade desenvolvida seja intuitiva, tecnicamente viável e visualmente impecável, elevando a maturidade de design dentro de um ecossistema complexo e dinâmico. Como será seu dia a dia? Trabalhar próximo aos times de Engenharia, Produto e áreas de negócio para definir e desenvolver soluções eficazes e novas funcionalidades; Identificar pontos de fricção e oportunidades em processos complexos (como faturamento, chamados técnicos ou serviços de gás); Conduzir pesquisas, entrevistas com usuários e testes de usabilidade para validar hipóteses antes da implementação; Liderar dinâmicas de brainstorm e workshops de co-criação com stakeholders; Aplicar princípios de Gestalt, tipografia e hierarquia visual para entregar interfaces de alto nível.  Para esta vaga, é essencial: Apresentação de casos reais, processos de pensamento e entregas visuais com um portfólio online atualizado; Experiência sólida com design de interação, definição de fluxos e prototipação funcional; Experiência prática em entrevistas, testes de usabilidade e métodos como card sorting e avaliação heurística; Habilidade para trabalhar com bibliotecas de componentes e manter a consistência visual; Domínio de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch ou similares; Conhecimento em Design Thinking, Lean UX e metodologias centradas no usuário; Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida em São Paulo/SP; Graduação ou cursos especializados em Design, UX ou áreas correlatas; Familiaridade com princípios de acessibilidade (diretrizes WCAG) para garantir produtos inclusivos para todos os perfis de usuários; Capacidade de argumentar e defender soluções de design baseadas em dados e evidências junto a stakeholders.  Você pode se destacar se: Tver experiência em consultoria, com facilidade para transitar entre diferentes contextos e lidar com stakeholders seniores; Já tiver atuado com Design Systems, participando da criação ou manutenção de guias de estilo e bibliotecas escaláveis; Possuir background no setor de Gás e Energia, com compreensão das particularidades, termos técnicos e fluxos de atendimento do segmento de utilities; Tiver perfil analítico, com conhecimento em métricas de uso e ferramentas de análise para embasar decisões de design; Já tiver visão de Produto, atuando lado a lado com PMs na definição de KPIs e priorização de roadmap.    Curtiu a oportunidade?  Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Nature-Based Solutions Expert, Brazil (Consultancy)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Nature-Based Solutions Expert, Brazil (Consultancy) em porto alegre. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Purpose  Pyxera Global, a US-based non-profit organization (more information below), seeks a local consultant or consulting team to support a focused scouting and preliminary maturity assessment process for community-rooted nature-based solutions (NbS) initiatives in Porto Alegre as part of the Community-Owned Urban Transitions for Growth and Resilience (COUGAR) initiative. COUGAR is a data-driven, place-based pipeline-to-portfolio system that identifies, prioritizes, structures, and advances community-rooted NbS initiatives toward finance readiness. This consultancy is intended to support COUGAR’s pipeline formation and maturity assessment function and should help Pyxera Global and partners answer a narrower and more operational question: which community-rooted initiatives, organizations, or emerging project concepts appear sufficiently relevant and mature to warrant deeper engagement through the COUGAR process. The objective is to: Identify and refine an initial pool of community-rooted organizations, initiatives, and emerging project concepts relevant to NbS in Porto Alegre. Conduct a preliminary maturity assessment using criteria provided or validated by Pyxera Global. Produce one or more short, vetted lists of initiatives that may be suitable for further intake, platform review, or follow-on engagement. Generate practical insights on what is and is not currently mature enough for COUGAR’s next steps.  Pyxera Global has conducted a preliminary identification of mature organizations and projects engaged in NBS-related initiatives. The consultant will expand, validate, and systematize this baseline into a more comprehensive citywide database, followed by structured maturity assessment. The assessment must distinguish between venture/startup acceleration models and the advancement pathways typical of social enterprises, NGOs, and community-based organizations. NOTE: This assignment is strictly ecosystem scouting and organizational assessment and does not  include project development, technical design, or capital intermediation.  Scope of Work  Inception Phase  Within one week of contract signature, the selected consultant will: Finalize a scouting and assessment methodology, including inclusion criteria, outreach approach, and the format for documenting findings. Align with Pyxera Global on maturity assessment criteria. Design the input structure for the ecosystem database, in consultation with Pyxera Global.  This refinement phase may run in parallel with desk research and contextual onboarding but must precede direct engagement with external actors. Ecosystem Mapping & Database Consolidation  The consultant will: Expand Pyxera Global’s preliminary list of mature NBS-related organizations and projects by identifying and capturing as many pilot- or later-stage NBS initiatives in Porto Alegre as feasible. Validate inclusion criteria and remove duplications. Consolidate existing and newly collected data into a streamlined database. Structure the database in consultation with Pyxera Global to enable lifecycle and friction analysis.  The database should include, at minimum: Organization type and scale Territorial focus Project description Project maturity stage (using criteria provided by Pyxera Global) Funding status and pathway Identified barriers or advancement constraints   Preliminary maturity assessment  Based on the scoped list, the consultant will carry out a light-touch maturity assessment through desk review and direct outreach.  The assessment should examine, as relevant: Whether there is a real initiative, project concept, or credible pathway to one. Whether there is an identifiable actor or implementing organization with sufficient absorptive capacity for further engagement. Whether the intervention has plausible NbS relevance and fits a real territorial context. Whether there is early traction, basic feasibility, or evidence that the concept could move toward pre-feasibility. Whether fatal constraints are already evident, such as lack of ownership, lack of implementer capacity, or no plausible municipal or community fit.  The consultant is not expected to provide engineering validation, full feasibility assessment, project design, or incubation support.   Shortlisting and iteration  This should include: A first vetted shortlist generated after the initial scouting and assessment round. A second round of targeted scouting and/or reassessment, if requested by Pyxera Global, based on gaps, lessons, or newly surfaced opportunities from the first round. Clear notation of which initiatives appear ready for deeper engagement, which should be monitored, and which should be deferred.  Deliverables  Method note and assessment framework:  A concise inception memo confirming methodology, inclusion criteria, assessment dimensions, and documentation format. (within two weeks of engagement). Scouting tracker / initiative list:  A structured spreadsheet or table capturing all scoped organizations, initiatives, and concepts reviewed, including status and key notes. Vetted shortlist - Round 1:  A short memo or slide-style brief summarizing the first set of initiatives assessed and identifying which appear most relevant for COUGAR follow-on review. Vetted shortlist - Round 2:  If requested, a second shortlist based on additional scouting and light-touch assessment after the first review cycle. Final summary note and presentation:  A concise summary of findings, patterns, and recommendations for next-step engagement, including key observations on what kinds of community-rooted initiatives appear most tractable for the current COUGAR phase.  Qualifications  The consultant(s) must demonstrate: Expertise in climate resilience and nature-based solutions and community-rooted urban interventions in Brazil. Demonstrated experience working in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments (e.g., municipal agencies, community organizations, funders) and navigating political sensitivities Familiarity with social enterprise and community-based initiative scaling pathways. Experience conducting interviews, screening exercises, or early-stage project assessments. Ability to design and manage structured data repository (e.g., Excel; advanced data science skills not required). Familiarity with Porto Alegre’s institutional or NbS ecosystem preferred. Based in Brazil required; Porto Alegre or Rio Grande do Sul strongly preferred  Fluency in Portuguese and English required  Reporting  The consultant will report directly to Pyxera Global’s COUGAR Senior Project Manager and coordinate regularly with the Pyxera Global team. Remuneration  This is a part-time consultant position with an estimated immediate start date   and up to 100 hours anticipated. Pay will be based on past experience, the type of work required for this position, and prevailing local market rates for similar work.  To Apply  Send a cover letter, resume, three references, and hourly salary requirements no later than 17 May 2026  via e-mail to . Please write “Porto Alegre NBS Diagnostic ” in the subject line of the e-mail.  Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and this opportunity may be closed before the final deadline if a suitable candidate is selected. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. If selected, Pyxera Global may elect to use the local project coordinator for future similar assignments. About Pyxera Global  Pyxera Global  is a nonprofit organization based in Washington, DC. For thirty-five years, we’ve created groundbreaking partnerships between the public, private, and social sectors, leveraging the unique attributes of each to create shared value and innovative solutions to complex challenges. We work across thematic social areas, including circular economies, equity in healthcare, small business growth, and bridging the digital divide. Our initiatives include a wide range of methodologies, including enterprise development, skills-based employee engagement and designing impactful corporate social responsibility strategies, and community partnership efforts that transform lives and livelihoods.  Pyxera Global endeavors to practice and elevate diversity, inclusion, and environmental sustainability within and outside of our organization. Visit our website to learn more!

description:

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador de Almoxarifado. O profissional será o catalisador da transformação logística da empresa. Sua missão principal é migrar de um modelo reativo para uma operação baseada em dados, processos e autoridade técnica. Ele será o guardião do mestre de materiais e o elo estratégico entre a Manutenção, Compras e a Malha de Distribuição. Principais Responsabilidades: • Liderar o saneamento da base de dados, eliminando duplicidades e implementando a Padronização Descritiva de Materiais (PDM). O objetivo é eliminar o bypass (solicitações diretas para compras), garantindo que toda necessidade passe pelo crivo técnico e de estoque. • Estruturar a política de estocagem para as 30 filiais. Definir cientificamente o que deve ser capilarizado (alto giro/peças críticas) e o que deve ser centralizado no CD (alto valor/baixo giro). • Implementar SLAs rígidos para criação de itens e expedição. Estabelecer o fluxo de "Quebra em Rota", garantindo agilidade no socorro mecânico sem comprometer a rastreabilidade financeira e o controle de estoque. • Transformar o cadastro em uma ferramenta estratégica para Compras, permitindo rodadas de negociação volumétricas baseadas em especificações técnicas precisas. Habilidades e Competências • Certificações em metodologias de gestão de processos ou logística. • Conhecimento em automação de armazéns (WMS). • Experiência com auditorias internas . • Capacidade para lidar com a resistência cultural à mudança, especialmente na interface com as oficinas e filiais. • Tomada de decisão baseada em indicadores (KPIs) e não em "sentimento". • Atitude proativa para bloquear perdas, desvios ou processos que gerem ineficiência financeira. Requisitos • Sólida experiência em gestão estratégica de almoxarifados e controle de inventário de alta complexidade. • Habilidade avançada em liderança de equipes, com foco em engajamento e retenção de talentos. • Capacidade analítica aguçada para transformar dados operacionais em planos de ação de melhoria (Lean, Kaizen ou Six Sigma). • Domínio de Sistemas ERP: Experiência avançada em módulos de estoque de grandes ERPs (Protheus, SAP, Oracle, etc.). • Excel Avançado: Capacidade de criar macros, tabelas dinâmicas e modelos de análise de dados. Formação Escolar Superior Completa em Administração, Logística, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas (Pós-graduação/MBA será um diferencial). Desejável 05 anos de experiência/atuação. Resuma estes dados Formação Superior Completa em Administração, Logística, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas (Pós-graduação/MBA será um diferencial). Desejável 05 anos de experiência/atuação.

title: Operations Finance Manager (Plant Controller)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Operations Finance Manager (Plant Controller) em são bernardo do campo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Role Overview:   The Operations Finance Manager (Plant Controller) will be responsible for cost accounting, inventory management, accounting governance, and financial planning for Otis' operations in Brazil. The role will involve working closely with manufacturing, operations, and senior leadership to ensure accurate results, financial discipline, and insights that drive operational efficiency and profitability. The Operations Finance Manager (Plant Controller) will lead a team of professionals and have high exposure to strategic processes, offering excellent growth potential within the organization. On a typical day, you will:   Conduct monthly and quarterly closings, including manufacturing variance calculations, COGS analysis, inventory reconciliations, and general ledger account reviews. Analyze manufacturing costs, standard vs. actual variations, and profitability by product, identifying drivers and opportunities for improvement. Develop, maintain, and review standard costs, labor rates, burden rates, and overhead allocations. Support the factory billing process, ensuring appropriate and timely adjustments for New Equipment and Modernization. Oversee intercompany accounting requirements, reconciliations, and dispute resolution, collaborating with other Otis entities to ensure timely invoicing and settlements. Conduct periodic reviews of freight expenses, provisions, and analyses (e.g., cost per load). Lead inventory management, evaluation, and reporting, including inventories, excess and obsolete (E&O) reserves, and perpetual inventory reconciliations. Monitor cost KPIs and operational drivers, providing proactive explanations of variances and recommendations. Ensure compliance with US GAAP and BR GAAP, internal controls, and corporate policies on costs and general accounting. Support internal and external audits, compliance reviews, and process improvements in cost accounting and general ledger. Prepare and present cost reports, financial analyses, and presentations to senior leadership. Collaborate with cross-functional teams for efficiency gains, process optimization, and standardization of accounting practices across operations. Participate in ad hoc analyses, special projects, and continuous improvement initiatives. Lead Financial Planning activities for Operations Finance (Annual Plan, Quarterly Forecasts, and monthly R&Os).  What You Need to Succeed:   Education & Experience:  Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related fields. 5+ years of leadership experience in cost accounting, general accounting, or FP&A, preferably in manufacturing. Technical Skills:  Strong command of cost accounting, variances, inventory valuation, and COGS. Experience with financial modeling, data analysis, and ERPs (preferably JD Edwards). Advanced Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, macros). Knowledge of HFM, Smart View, and QlikView is desirable.  Apply now! #BuildWhatsNext

Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Nós oferecemos uma remuneração competitiva e a oportunidade de trabalho remoto em regime parcial. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira; um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. Você fará parte de uma equipe altamente motivada e dinâmica, e terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, além de capacitação e orientação profissional junto de colegas de equipe experientes. Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio. Sobre a SIG  A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor. Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange.

instruções de produção e embalagem, além de ministrar treinamentos técnicos. • Gerar e acompanhar indicadores (KPIs), apoiando a tomada de decisão da gestão. • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas processos e assegurando o cumprimento das BPF. • Zelar pela confidencialidade das informações e atuar com integridade nos registros (ALCOA+) e normas de segurança (EHS). • Disponibilidade para viagens title: Desenvolvedor de Firmware — Sistemas Embarcados (C / ARM Cortex-M / ESP32)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Desenvolvedor de Firmware — Sistemas Embarcados (C / ARM Cortex-M / ESP32) em palhoça. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sobre a Ageon  Somos uma indústria eletrônica brasileira que, desde 2001, desenvolve, produz e comercializa controladores de temperatura e inversores de frequência  para os mercados de refrigeração, aquecimento, climatização, fitness e automação industrial. Nossos produtos rodam em aplicações no Brasil e no exterior, sustentados por três pilares: inovação, tecnologia e melhoria contínua . Conheça em ageon.com.br. Sobre a vaga  Estamos reforçando nosso time de P&D para acelerar o desenvolvimento da próxima geração de produtos. Você participará do ciclo completo do firmware — da arquitetura à homologação — em produtos reais que vão para o chão de fábrica de clientes em vários setores. É uma oportunidade para quem gosta de resolver problemas técnicos de baixo nível, entender o hardware ao seu redor e ver o código rodando em algo físico . O que você vai fazer  Projetar, codificar e validar firmware em C  para microcontroladores ARM Cortex-M  e ESP32 . Implementar rotinas de leitura de sensores, controle e comunicação com periféricos via SPI, I²C, UART. Desenvolver e manter protocolos de comunicação industrial (Modbus RTU/TCP , RS-485) e conectividade IoT (Wi-Fi, MQTT) . Trabalhar lado a lado com a equipe de hardware na depuração e bring-up de placas. Criar e manter testes preliminares, documentação técnica e versionamento dos firmwares no repositório (Git). Planejar cronograma, contribuir com decisões de arquitetura e encaminhar projetos para homologação. Evoluir produtos existentes conforme novas demandas dos clientes e do mercado.  O que esperamos de você (requisitos)  Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de firmware/software embarcado em linguagem C . Vivência com microcontroladores ARM Cortex-M  (STM32) e ESP32 . Domínio de periféricos e protocolos embarcados (UART, SPI, I²C, GPIO, timers, interrupções). Familiaridade com Git  e fluxo de versionamento. Capacidade de ler datasheets em inglês . Formação em Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia Eletrônica/Elétrica, Mecatrônica, Automação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins (ou experiência equivalente).  Diferenciais (não eliminatórios)  Experiência com aplicações IoT  e arquiteturas conectadas (MQTT , brokers, integração com nuvem). Vivência com FreeRTOS  ou outro RTOS. Conhecimento em Modbus , RS-485 ou outros protocolos industriais. Experiência com bootloaders e atualização OTA / firmware update . Pós-graduação ou especialização em Sistemas Embarcados, Engenharia de Software, Desenvolvimento de Produtos ou áreas correlatas.  O que oferecemos  Estabilidade de uma indústria com 25 anos de mercado  e produtos próprios. Plano de saúde. Vale alimentação ou refeição. Vale-transporte e estacionamento no local. Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR) . Convênios com farmácia, academia, centro de estética, restaurantes e instituições de ensino (técnico, graduação e pós-graduação) — incentivo direto à sua formação continuada. Ambiente técnico onde você verá seu firmware rodando em produtos físicos vendidos no Brasil e exterior.  Detalhes da vaga  Regime:  CLT (efetivo) Modelo:  Presencial — Jardim Eldorado, Palhoça/SC Horário:  Segunda a quinta, das 8h às 12h e das 13h às 18h; sextas, das 8h às 12h e das 13h às 17h Nível:  Júnior / Pleno

title: Auxiliar de produção
description:

Sobre a Allinsert:  A Allinsert é uma empresa nacional com sólida experiência no mercado de manufatura eletrônica, atuando desde 2005 na montagem de placas e produtos eletrônicos (Contract Manufacturing). Localizada em Pinhais, Paraná, nossa unidade fabril de mais de 1.000m² conta com três modernas linhas SMD e uma linha PTH, equipadas com tecnologia de ponta para garantir a mais alta qualidade em nossos processos. Atendemos clientes de diversos segmentos, desde a prototipagem até a produção em larga escala, sempre prezando pela qualidade, agilidade e segurança. Na Allinsert, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento profissional.  Objetivo da Posição:  Buscamos um profissional para integrar nossa equipe de produção como Auxiliar de Produção I, com foco na inspeção de qualidade da montagem de placas de circuito impresso (PCI). Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para quem deseja iniciar sua carreira na indústria eletrônica, aprendendo sobre os processos de fabricação e garantindo a excelência do nosso serviço. Principais Funções:  Análise de perfil de solda:  Verificar a qualidade da soldagem, identificando defeitos como solda fria, excesso de solda, bolhas ou rachaduras. Inspeção de componentes montados:  Conferir se os componentes estão posicionados corretamente e bem fixados nas placas. Verificação de polaridade:  Identificar resistores, diodos, capacitores eletrolíticos e transistores montados de forma invertida. Inspeção de conectores e terminais:  Checar a integridade dos conectores e terminais, verificando a ausência de curtos-circuitos ou trilhas rompidas na PCI. Registro de não conformidades:  Documentar de forma precisa os defeitos recorrentes encontrados durante a inspeção e comunicar as informações ao time de engenharia de qualidade. Retrabalho de placas defeituosas (quando necessário):  Realizar a remoção e substituição de componentes defeituosos, seguindo os procedimentos estabelecidos. Sugestão de melhorias:  Identificar padrões de erros na montagem e proativamente sugerir ajustes no processo de fabricação para evitar recorrências. Seguir normas de qualidade:  Cumprir rigorosamente os procedimentos e normas de qualidade implementados, em conformidade com a norma ISO 9001. Preenchimento de relatórios:  Registrar de forma clara e organizada os problemas identificados durante as inspeções, garantindo a rastreabilidade dos lotes analisados.  Buscamos em você:  Interesse em aprender:  Forte desejo de adquirir novos conhecimentos sobre processos de produção eletrônica e inspeção de qualidade. Capacidade de comunicação:  Habilidade para expressar dúvidas de forma clara e buscar feedback para aprimorar seu trabalho. Responsabilidade:  Compromisso com os horários de trabalho e com a presença na empresa. Comprometimento:  Dedicação à qualidade do trabalho e consciência do seu papel como contribuinte para um ambiente de trabalho positivo. Posicionamento Pró-ativo:  Iniciativa para buscar atividades e ajudar mesmo quando sua tarefa principal não tiver demanda imediata, visando a melhoria contínua da empresa. Conforto fora da zona de conforto:  Disposição para enfrentar novos desafios e aprender novas tarefas, saindo da rotina quando necessário.  Diferenciais (Não Obrigatórios):  Conhecimento básico em componentes eletrônicos. Familiaridade com processos de montagem eletrônica (SMD e PTH).  O que oferecemos:  Oportunidade de iniciar sua carreira em uma empresa sólida e em crescimento no setor de eletrônica. Treinamento e desenvolvimento profissional. Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e que valoriza a iniciativa. Salário inicial R$2,011.68 Vale Refeição R$22,00/dia  Jornada de trabalho:  Segunda à quinta feira das 7:30 às 17:30 e  Sexta feira das 7:30 às 16:30.  Não trabalhamos aos sábados.  Se você se identifica com esta oportunidade e possui o perfil que buscamos, candidate-se e venha fazer parte da equipe Allinsert!

Position Overview:  We invite researchers and scientists to join us as Section Editor  for the journal, "Current Cell Science"  , to contribute to a research area (section) most relevant to their field of expertise. The candidates for the Section Editor  position should have a proven track record of scholarly publishing and organizing a Topical Issue, and they should be able to assemble a collection of high-quality research/review articles related to their section. Key Responsibilities:  Developing a comprehensive proposal for a special issue, highlighting its importance and detailing prospective contributors. Collaborating with possible co-editors to effectively organize the special issue and coordinate with authors, ensuring a smooth editorial process. Inviting contributors from diverse regions, focusing on those with a proven publication record. Promoting the special issue to enhance its visibility and impact.  Qualifications and Experience:  • Ph.D. in related fields • A valid Scopus ID. • Prior experience in publishing guest-edited thematic issues in peer-reviewed journals. • They must have a list of scholarly authors who can consent to contribute research / review articles in the thematic issue(s) proposed by the Topical Issue. • Strong networks within the research community. • Excellent communication and organizational skills. • Familiarity with scientific publication and peer review processes. Benefits:  • An honorarium to support thematic issue promotion and academic & research endeavors. • Rapid publication of the special issue, with articles going online within 30 days of acceptance. • Full APC waiver for an article authored by the Topical Issue. • A free online subscription to all articles published in the journal during the year. Location:  This is a remote opportunity, offering flexibility and convenience. How To Apply:  Interested candidates are invited to submit their CVs; list of publications, and a Topical issue proposal by 25 May 2026. The proposal should include the title and scope of the Topical issue, relevant keywords, sub-topics, and preferably, the article titles, a list of potential contributors, and article submission deadlines. Special Instructions:  • Each author/co-author is welcome to contribute one paper to the Topical Issue. • Contributions must adhere to topics approved by the Editor-in-Chief. • Manuscript submission extensions will be limited to 60 days. Additional Offer:  In our ongoing efforts to expand our Editorial team, we are pleased to offer the successful Section Editors a potential for advancement within the Editorial Board. Based on qualifications and contributions, outstanding editors may be considered for prestigious positions on our Editorial Board. *The provision of Scopus ID is a MUST for the application to be shortlisted.

Descrição:  Médicos que atuam em regime de plantão muitas vezes enfrentam um problema comum: o trabalho já foi feito, mas o pagamento só chega 30, 60 ou até 90 dias depois. A Plantão à Vista nasceu para ajudar médicos plantonistas a terem mais controle sobre o próprio fluxo de caixa, permitindo a antecipação de valores referentes a plantões já realizados e com pagamento previsto. O processo é simples, digital e transparente. Você informa os dados dos plantões, envia a documentação necessária, escolhe o valor que deseja antecipar e recebe uma proposta com todas as condições antes de confirmar. Essa solução é indicada para médicos que desejam:  Ter mais previsibilidade financeira no mês; Evitar depender do calendário de pagamento de hospitais, clínicas ou escalas; Reduzir o uso de crédito caro para cobrir despesas pessoais; Receber mais rápido por plantões já realizados; Organizar melhor o fluxo de caixa sem burocracia excessiva. A liquidez pode ocorrer em até 24 horas após o envio dos documentos e aprovação da operação, com taxas apresentadas de forma transparente antes da confirmação.  Como funciona:  Você realiza um cadastro inicial e nossa equipe entra em contato para orientar os próximos passos. Importante:  Trata-se de uma solução financeira para médicos que desejam antecipar recebíveis de plantões já realizados. Clique em “Candidatar-se” ou preencha o formulário para falar com o time da Plantão à Vista e entender se seus plantões são elegíveis para antecipação.

Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você conquista a confiança e o respeito das pessoas com facilidade. Você vê os erros como oportunidades para aprender. title: Technical solution engineer - sao paulo
description:
Confira a vaga para Technical solution engineer - sao paulo em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About CATL CATL invites you to continue our legend of green energy! CATL is a World Fortune 300 Company, a global leader who provides premier EV battery and energy storage battery for the world. CATL's EV battery consumption volume has ranked No.1 in the world for seven consecutive years and global energy storage battery shipment has also ranked No.1 for three consecutive years. Job Description ESS Technical Solution Engineer is the combination of application engineer and sales engineer. A technical solution engineer should support and service the customer by demonstrating the product function, technical benefits and value to help customer meet their company and business goals and help company to win projects. Combining technical knowledge with strong communication and interpersonal skills, work closely with clients, understanding their specific needs, and then leverage their in-depth understanding of the company's products or services to provide tailored solutions that meet those needs effectively. Additionally, technical solution engineers should gather feedback from clients and bridge the gap between internal development team and customer requirements, helping to refine products and services based on customer needs and experiences. Responsibilities: Product Demonstration: Deep understanding of the products or services of products and company. Be able to explain complex technical concepts to clients in a clear and understandable manner and contribute to sales presentations, as well as demonstrating products benefits, value and completed applications Client Engagement: Interact directly with clients to understand their needs, challenges, and requirements as well as the competition information from the competitors. Engage in discussions to gather information, analyze the client's projects and requirements, and identify opportunities where company's solutions can add value to win the opportunities Solution Development: Once understand the client's needs, sales engineers work to develop solutions that align with the client's projects. This may involve collaborating with the technical team to design tailored solutions that address specific challenges. Provide clients with technical support as needed and relay information to our development teams for product development and update needs Proposal Creation: Create detailed proposals that outline the proposed solution and its benefits. These proposals need to address the technical aspects while also highlighting the business value for the client as well as prepare the documents according to customer requirements which may include specifications, user's manual, disposal proposal, etc., Technical Support: Provide ongoing technical support to clients, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping with any technical issues that arise Technical Agreement Negotiations: Involve in negotiations with clients, addressing any technical concerns, clarifying expectations, and ensuring that both parties are aligned on the proposed solution to form final technical agreement Risk Assessment and Problem Solving: Identify the possible issues ahead and provide preventative solutions for the risks. Resolve the technical issues during manufacturing, delivering and commissioning until successfully hand over to customer. Cooperate with internal development and project management team if needed Market Research: Stay informed about market trends, competitor offerings, and customer feedback. Generate ideas for product and service improvement and innovation based on market trends and customer inputs  Requirements and skills: Based in (or open to relocation) Sao Paulo At least 2 years work experience in local ESS market Previous work experience as an AE or SE of ESS market is advantageous Previous experience in utility or ESS developer company is advantageous Knowledge of local ESS projects development requirements is advantageous Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills Excellent market and competitor analysis abilities Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities Superb collaboration and communication Superb logical and strategic thinking abilities Proficient in English & Portuguese

title: Clinical application specialist
description:

A pioneer in its field, Echosens significantly changed the practice of liver diagnosis with Fibro Scan, the non-invasive gold standard solution for comprehensive management of liver health. Fibro Scan is recognized worldwide as the reference for liver fibrosis and liver steatosis assessment with more than 5 380+ peer-reviewed publications and 210+ international guidelines. Echosens has made Fibro Scan available in over 127 countries through its network of subsidiaries in Europe (Germany, Spain, UK, Italy), the United States and China (Shanghai, Shenzen and Hong Kong), enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide. Echosens is shaping the future of liver health. As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care. In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes. Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health. To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a: CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W) LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil) The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education. This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients. Main activities: Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens Fibro Scan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise  Experience / Education / Special Requirements You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems. You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset. Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese and English, you are comfortable communicating across diverse teams and healthcare settings. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are experienced in coordinating training programs, clinical implementation processes, and other operational methodologies. You are results-driven, proactive, and self-sufficient, able to identify opportunities, gain consensus, and execute solutions efficiently. Your integrity, trustworthiness, and commitment to diversity of thought, combined with strong relationship-building and communication skills, enable you to excel in international healthcare environments. Please submit your application and CV in English. Why join ECHOSENS ? Work on high-impact projects, serving the health of patients around the world. Join a growing, innovative company, where your ideas will be valued and where you can make a difference. Benefit from a collaborative and stimulating work environment, with opportunities for professional development. Contribute to cutting-edge products, within a team passionate about innovation. Adhere to our inclusion, equality and diversity program set up to support our employees in their efforts to be recognized as workers with disabilities.  ECHOSENS is an equal opportunity company in an environment of diversity and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, health or disability, or any other status protected by law.

Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R& D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets. Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience: 1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry. 2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc. 3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry. 4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills. 5. Willingness to travel. 6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred ) 7. Base Sao Paulo. Competences: a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry. b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent. Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em araras. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em barretos. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em ivoti. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em caieiras. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
